Bhd. (2024–present) | awards = | website = {{URL|https://lostcontrol.fun/}} | module = {{Infobox Chinese |child=yes |hide=no |headercolor=lightblue |t = 大穎 |s = 大颖 |p = Dàyǐng |altname = Birth name |t2 = 陳佳瑩 |s2 = 陈佳莹 |p2 = Chén Jiāyǐng }} }} '''DIOR''' ({{zh|s=DIOR大颖}}, born '''Tan Jia Ying''' {{zh|s=陈佳莹}} on February 26, 1999), is a [[Malaysians|Malaysian]] singer-songwriter and record producer. She first rose to prominence in 2020 with her viral single, ''Love Myself More (爱自己更深)'', which launched her professional music career.{{cite web|url=https://www.kwongwah.com.my/20200117/%E6%96%B9%E7%82%AF%E9%95%93%E4%B8%BAdior%E6%89%93%E9%80%A0%E3%80%8A%E7%88%B1%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E6%9B%B4%E6%B7%B1%E3%80%8B-%E6%8A%96%E9%9F%B3%E4%B8%80%E5%A4%9C%E7%88%86%E7%BA%A2/|title=方炯镓为dior打造《爱自己更深》 抖音一夜爆红|date=2020-01-17|access-date=2025-03-24|publisher=Kwong Wah Yit Poh|archive-date=2020-01-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200117232447/http://www.kwongwah.com.my/20200117/%e6%96%b9%e7%82%af%e9%95%93%e4%b8%badior%e6%89%93%e9%80%a0%e3%80%8a%e7%88%b1%e8%87%aa%e5%b7%b1%e6%9b%b4%e6%b7%b1%e3%80%8b-%e6%8a%96%e9%9f%b3%e4%b8%80%e5%a4%9c%e7%88%86%e7%ba%a2/}} Since then, she has released a number of [[originality|original]] and collaborative tracks, and later established her own music studio, LostControl, to support her music production and creative work.{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://lostcontrol.fun/pages/lostcontrol-studio-1 |access-date=2026-03-22 |website=LOSTCONTROL |language=en}} DIOR has remained active primarily in Malaysia, with her music widely circulated across digital platforms. Notable tracks such as ''Divorce in Ghana (在加纳共和国离婚)'' and ''If That Call Had Been Answered (如果那通电话有接通)'' gained widespread popularity in [[China]] and were featured on major [[streaming platform]]s, also receiving recognition from music awards.{{cite web|url=https://www.douyin.com/note/7449633255587892515|title=2024年汽水音乐&抖音《看见音乐计划·年度盛典》荣誉名单|author=抖音音乐|website=Douyin|date=2024-12-18|access-date=2025-03-25|language=zh}} ==Early life== DIOR was raised in a family engaged in the [[audio equipment]] business. Influenced by her parents’ passion for singing, she developed a keen interest in music from an early age. She made her first stage appearance in 2011, competing in the [[Hokkien]] singing competition ''[[Astro Hua Hee Dai|Astro Hua Hee Karaoke]]''. In 2016, she joined the national singing competition ''"绝对星光飙唱赛"'' organized by Easynote Studio and began posting cover songs online.{{cite web|url=https://www.pinprestige.com/my/lifestyle/people/malaysian-new-generation-inspiring-singer/|title=值得关注的马来西亚新生代歌手|publisher=Pin Prestige|author=戴秀慧|date=2024-08-28|access-date=2025-03-24}} After finishing high school that year, she joined a band and started performing as a bar singer, later signing with a seaside resort in [[Port Dickson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.goody25.com/mind9125208|title="当时没什么钱，但很快乐"DIOR大颖分享【从素人变成歌手的经历】：原本五十人到几千人的演唱会！|author=LohHorTii|publisher=Goody25|date=2024-02-29|access-date=2025-03-31|language=zh}} In December 2019, she appeared on the Malaysian web [[reality show]] ''Produce KOL Trainee Musical'', where she advanced to the finals{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/kolsmalaysia/p/B7Yqj3FnJRm/|title=Produce KOL Trainee Musical|author=KOLS Malaysia|website=Instagram|date=2020-01-16|access-date=2025-05-01}} ==Career== ===2020–2022: Online Debut and Career Beginnings=== On January 3, 2020, DIOR won the [[TikTok]] Song Cover Challenge at the [[Anugerah Industri Muzik|AIM]] Chinese Music Awards with her cover of ''Still Friends (依然是朋友)'', and was invited to open the ceremony.{{cite web|url=https://www.tiktok.com/@aimchinese/video/677767122007582643|title=#AIM名曲挑战 在TikTok挑战成功的是DIOR大颖|author=2020 AIM Chinese Music Awards|website=TikTok|date=2020-01-03|access-date=2025-03-26|language=zh}} DIOR officially debuted on January 13, 2020, with the single ''Love Myself More (爱自己更深)''. Upon its release on [[Douyin]] and [[YouTube]], the single quickly surpassed 400,000 streams within 24 hours, capturing widespread online and media attention.{{cite web|url=https://www.kwongwah.com.my/20200117/%E6%96%B9%E7%82%AF%E9%95%93%E4%B8%BAdior%E6%89%93%E9%80%A0%E3%80%8A%E7%88%B1%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E6%9B%B4%E6%B7%B1%E3%80%8B-%E6%8A%96%E9%9F%B3%E4%B8%80%E5%A4%9C%E7%88%86%E7%BA%A2/|title=方炯镓为dior打造《爱自己更深》 抖音一夜爆红|date=2020-01-17|access-date=2025-03-24|publisher=Kwong Wah Yit Poh|archive-date=2020-01-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200117232447/http://www.kwongwah.com.my/20200117/%e6%96%b9%e7%82%af%e9%95%93%e4%b8%badior%e6%89%93%e9%80%a0%e3%80%8a%e7%88%b1%e8%87%aa%e5%b7%b1%e6%9b%b4%e6%b7%b1%e3%80%8b-%e6%8a%96%e9%9f%b3%e4%b8%80%e5%a4%9c%e7%88%86%e7%ba%a2/}} Through a recommendation by Malaysian singer-songwriter {{ill|KC PNG|zh|方炯镓}}, she was invited to ''Alone (一个人)'', the theme song for the Chinese film ''{{ill|Ladies in Beijing 4|zh|北京女子图鉴}}''.{{cite web|url=https://www.sinchew.com.my/news/20210109/entertainment/3178805|title=靠社群与串流建立人气 5新星歌手网络出圈|author=谢丽芬|publisher=Sin Chew Daily|date=2021-01-09|access-date=2025-03-26|language=zh}} With live shows halted during the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], she shifted to [[online content]], releasing the original single ''How to Forgive (该怎么原谅)'' and several cover tracks. ===2023–Present: Breakthrough and Gained Recognition Overseas === Following the pandemic, DIOR resumed live performances, which during this period were primarily held as small-scale solo showcases. On February 26, 2023, her 24th birthday, she headlined her first solo show, ''"I Want to Earn 1Million!"'' in [[Johor Bahru]], where she surprised the audience by offering a full ticket refund.{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/CpUuLIhA3Ii/?igsh=MWlmbjZkOGpieW0ycw%3D%3D|title=我要带著原創專輯再來一場|author=DIOR|website=Instagram|date=2023-03-03|access-date=2025-04-15|language=zh}} On August 14, 2023, DIOR released her first collaborative single, ''Divorce in Ghana (在加纳共和国离婚)'' featuring [[Firdhaus Farmizi]]. The track immediately topped multiple major Chinese streaming-platform charts and became one of the breakthrough Mandarin singles of the year.{{cite web|url=https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MjM5NzgyMzEwMA==&mid=2650932601&idx=1&sn=0e3a52520af9c87eef37a44c5ee4addd&chksm=bc108f94d67697e4df29d8acfee63ebda4a63fbb8119b4fb6ba9c2a8af8efaf10e6b8ba10f8f&scene=27|title=和女友唱离婚神曲创造破亿神话是什么感受？！|author=广东音乐之声|website=WeChat|date=2024-04-05|access-date=2025-03-31|language=zh}} Her first self-composed original song, ''I've Been Better (你最近过得好吗?)'', was released on December 12, 2023, in remembrance of her mother, who died in a car accident. In May 2024, DIOR released ''If That Call Had Been Answered (如果那通电话有接通)'', an original song honoring her late mother. Inspired by DIOR’s real past experience, the music video captures both the immediate trauma and its lingering echo. The lyrics progress from regret and guilt through fond memories of her time with her mother, ending with acceptance and a final blessing.{{cite web|url=https://www.goody25.com/mind86127008|title=曾在节目上谈起妈妈出车祸的悲痛经历... DIOR大颖【新歌上线超催泪】，揭Tomato私下暖心一面！|author=LohHorTii|publisher=Goody25|date=2024-05-13|access-date=2025-04-19|language=zh}} The song was later covered by Chinese singer [[Zhang Xincheng]] on the popular music variety show ''{{ill|Singing with Legends Season 6|zh|我们的歌 (第六季)}}''.{{cite web|url=https://www.sinchew.com.my/news/20241218/entertainment/6157973|title=人生第1首自创曲入选当代流行歌单大颖激动告白亡母|publisher=Sin Chew Daily|date=2024-12-18|access-date=2025-04-09|language=zh}} On December 4, ''Divorce in Ghana'' ranked as the second most-streamed Mandarin-language song on [[Spotify]] for the year.{{cite web|url=https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX5KtaZhtKgCY|title=Best of 最 Hit 華語榜 2024|website=Spotify|date=2024-12-04|access-date=2025-04-03}} It was later named one of the Top 10 Golden Songs of the Year and included in the Trending Pop Playlist at the ''2024 Soda Music & [[Douyin]] Music Awards'', while ''If That Call Had Been Answered'' was also included in the Trending Pop Playlist.{{cite web|url=https://www.douyin.com/note/7449633255587892515|title=2024年汽水音乐&抖音《看见音乐计划·年度盛典》荣誉名单|author=抖音音乐|website=Douyin|date=2024-12-18|access-date=2025-03-25|language=zh}} Intending to further support her music production and creative projects, DIOR announced the establishment of her personal studio, ''LostControl'', on December 31, 2024. Following this, her original releases have primarily been issued under the studio’s copyright.{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://lostcontrol.fun/pages/lostcontrol-studio-1 |access-date=2026-02-18 |website=LOSTCONTROL |language=en}} In 2025, DIOR maintained an active schedule in live performances and related industry activities, appearing on multiple regional stages. On January 27, during Chinese New Year celebrations in [[Batu Pahat]], DIOR staged a mini showcase titled ''Messing With 80 Cents: Personal Spring Festival Gala (8毛钱皮在痒个人春晚大会)''.{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/DFpzvKmvpe6/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==|title=最近喜歡的歌 和演出 和觀眾|author=DIOR|website=Instagram|date=2025-02-04|access-date=2025-04-09|language=zh}} In June, DIOR was selected as a [[Spotify]] EQUAL Asia ambassador for the month, with her profile featured on Spotify playlists in [[Singapore]] and [[Malaysia]] and on digital billboards in [[New York Times Square]].{{Cite web |date=2025-06-10 |title=大颖登上纽约时代广场大荧幕！激动喊话：让我的声音被世界听见 {{!}} XUAN |url=https://xuan.com.my/entertainment/dior-daying-shows-times-square-screen-99002 |access-date=2026-02-15 |website=xuan.com.my |language=zh-hans}} In the same month, she traveled to [[London]] for a one-month professional training, during which she planned and held a free-entry solo showcase.{{cite web|url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/next-time-me-is-not-now-me-tickets-1419126939879?aff=oddtdtcreator|title=Next time me is not 【NOW ME】伦敦莫名其妙失控大会|website=Eventbrite|access-date=2025-07-14}} On July 4, DIOR made her debut performance of original works in [[Singapore]] at the ''Sundown Festival'' as the only invited Malaysian singer.{{cite web|url=https://sundownfestival.com/music-line-up/|title=Music Line Up|website=Sundown Festival|access-date=2025-07-04}} On August 8, ''[[8TV (Malaysian TV network)|8TV]] Starfluence Award 2025'' she received four awards, which are Top 30 Starfluencer, Top 10 Chinese Song for ''If That Call Had Been Answered (如果那通电话有接通)'' and ''See You (有天会再相见),'' and Top 10 Chinese New Year Song for ''Le You You (乐油油).'' By winning four awards, she became one of the biggest winners of the night.{{Cite web |date=2025-08-09 |title=最霸娱乐盛典 |url=https://www.chinapress.com.my/20250809/%e6%9c%80%e9%9c%b8%e5%a8%b1%e4%b9%90%e7%9b%9b%e5%85%b8%ef%bd%9c%e5%9f%b9%e6%b0%b8%e6%9c%80%e5%a4%a7%e8%b5%a2%e5%ae%b6%e5%be%97%e5%b9%b4%e5%ba%a6%e6%9c%80%e9%9c%b8%e5%a4%a7%e5%a5%96/ |access-date=2026-01-18 |website=中國報 China Press |language=zh-CN}} She also held her first unannounced solo showcase in [[Taiwan]] as a small-scale live performance on November 17.{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/DROOAemk8Pz/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link|title=【大穎突襲隱世｜深夜限定場 】|author=台北隱世餐酒館(@thearcadiabistro) |website=Instagram|date=2025-11-18|access-date=2025-12-22}} On December 13 of the same year, DIOR held her first solo concert since her debut, “''Kampung Girl”'', at the [[Arena of Stars]], [[Genting Highlands]].{{Cite web |date=2025-12-14 |title=大颖首唱爆满 留位亡母：这里离天堂最近 |url=https://www.chinapress.com.my/20251214/%e5%a4%a7%e9%a2%96%e9%a6%96%e5%94%b1%e7%88%86%e6%bb%a1-%e7%95%99%e4%bd%8d%e4%ba%a1%e6%af%8d%ef%bc%9a%e8%bf%99%e9%87%8c%e7%a6%bb%e5%a4%a9%e5%a0%82%e6%9c%80%e8%bf%91/ |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=中國報 China Press |language=zh-CN}} Before the concert began, she announced that she would officially launch the ''“Kampung Girl”'' World Tour next year. The Sarawak stop is scheduled for March 14, 2026, followed by a performance in Singapore on March 28. Other tour cities include Taipei, Bali, London, and Melbourne, among others.{{Cite web |date=2025-12-06 |title=DIOR大颖2026年世界巡演 《KAMPUNG GIRL普通人》唱进砂新台等6城市 {{!}} 娱乐 |url=https://www.orientaldaily.com.my/news/entertainment/2025/12/06/781491 |access-date=2026-02-14 |website=東方網 馬來西亞東方日報 |language=zh-Hans}} ===2026: Began World Tour=== On March 14, 2026, DIOR performed at the Miri Indoor Stadium in [[Miri]], [[Sarawak]] for the ''"Kampung Girl"'' World Tour Sarawak stop. This concert marked the first show of the world tour. To make the show in Miri same as the one in Genting, she and the organizer transported the stage lift all the way from [[Kuala Lumpur]], making sure local fans could enjoy a production on the same scale as the Genting performance. During the concert, she performed ''Dear My Crush (给我的Crush)'' and ''Lifetime of Us (人的这一生)'' live for the first time, with the latter marking its first live performance since the song's official release. The concert perform lasted over three hours.{{Cite web |date=2026-03-16 |title=DIOR大颖美里开唱超宠粉！派送3000支冰淇淋还坐"蟑螂摩托车"绕场 |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DV81q9WEnCX/?igsh=OXprcW5odHZuaWt4 |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=Instagram|last=Woah.MY}} Following the Sarawak stop, the [[Singapore]] stop of the ''"Kampung Girl"'' World Tour was held on March 28 at [[The Star, Singapore|The Star Theatre]]. This concert was the first overseas stop of the tour and marked DIOR’s first solo overseas concert. During the performance, she sang several exclusive songs, including ''Like Sunday, Like Rain (像晴天像雨天), Like a Swallow (如燕) and The Next Dawn (下一个天亮).'' She also shared her past experiences and anecdotes in Singapore. Besides, she mentioned that her next Singapore concert will be held at the [[Singapore Indoor Stadium]].{{Cite web |date=2026-04-07 |title=DIOR大颖专访：从《Kampung Girl普通人》巡演到真实表达，简单纯粹也能动人 |url=https://www.nuyou.com.sg/celebs/exclusive-interview-diorlying-kampung-girl-ordinary-tour-singapore |access-date=2026-04-08 |website=NUYOU Singapore |language=zh-SG}} The tour later continued to [[Taipei]], with shows held on April 16 and 17 at [[Zepp New Taipei]]. Tickets sold out quickly, leading to the addition of an extra show on April 16. Her singles ''Save Some (节约用爱)'', ''See You (有天会再相见)'' and ''If That Call Had Been Answered (如果那通电话有接通)'', achieved high streaming numbers in [[Taiwan]], gradually building a local listener base. On the first day, she performed a new single, ''Mutual Friends (靠关系)'', which was her third collaboration with {{ill|Alex Chang Jie|zh|张简君伟}}.{{Cite web |title=PlayMusic音樂網 - 八億點擊馬來西亞創作女聲DIOR大穎 演唱會秒殺 再推新單曲〈靠關係〉 |url=https://www.playmusic.tw/column_info.php?id=27299&type=news |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=Play Music|archive-date=|date=2026-04-14}} The music video surpassed 1 million views on [[YouTube]] within 8 days of its release. On the second day, she performed ''Almost, But Still Here (欲落未落),'' an unreleased song, marking its first live performance.{{Cite web |last= |date=2026-04-18 |title=MTV音樂頻道 {{!}} 從普通女孩到國際舞台 DIOR大穎一連兩天台北演唱會見證夢想成真 新歌首唱獻台粉 |url=https://www.mtv.com.tw/news/newsdetail/13317?v=1777727617 |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=MTV音樂頻道MTV音樂頻道}} Following the Taipei stop, she held the Bali stop on June 6 at [[Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park|Lotus Pond, GWK]], in [[Bali]], [[Indonesia]]. The Bali performance marked DIOR's first outdoor solo concert. She also became the first [[Malaysian Chinese]] singer to stage a solo concert on the island. To accommodate the outdoor venue environment, the concert production team redesigned the stage and visual effects, utilising the hillsides on both sides of the venue for large-scale projection displays, and adjusted about 50% of the performance repertoire. During the finale, a firework display was presented as a closing segment of the show.{{Cite web |date=2026-05-04 |title=大颖606唱进印尼峇里岛 成首位大马中文歌手开唱 {{!}} 娱乐 |url=https://www.orientaldaily.com.my/news/entertainment/2026/05/04/815928 |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=東方網 馬來西亞東方日報 |language=zh-Hans}} On June 13, she performed at the ''21st'' ''[[KKBox|KKBOX]]'' ''Music Awards'' at [[Taipei Arena]], where she also received the Top 100 Artists award. That evening, in addition to performing her signature songs, she performed a collaboration stage with {{ill|Trevor Kuo|zh|郭家玮}} marking their first live performance in Taiwan of ''A Few Days (过了几天)''.{{Cite web |date=2026-05-20 |title=KKBOX 風雲榜 韋禮安與陳華強強聯手 李竺芯揪葛仲珊組女力聯盟 郭家瑋與大穎重現對唱金曲 - 台灣中央傳媒（TCN Media） |url=https://tcnmedia.net/115260/ |access-date=2026-06-16 |language=zh-TW}} The song previously reached No. 1 on YouTube trending in Malaysia, Singapore, and Taiwan, while its music video surpassed 10 million views within four months of release. It later entered the top 10 of the 2025 KKBOX Top Mandarin Yearly Singles Chart.{{Cite web |title=KKBOX 華語年度單曲累積榜誰來封王！ |url=https://kma.kkbox.com/charts/yearly/newrelease?terr=tw&lang=tc&cate=297&year=2025 |access-date=2026-06-16 |website=KKBOX 風雲榜榜單 |language=zh}} On June 27, the [[Penang]] stop was held at [[SPICE Arena]]. Penang was where DIOR began her music career and made her debut. The show marked her largest solo concert to date, with an audience of 8,000 people. During the performance, in addition to performing exclusive songs, she performed her new single ''She Is Not That Girl Anymore (她已不再是那个女孩)'' live for the first time.{{Cite web |last= |date=2026-06-29 |title=大颖槟城开唱8000歌迷热情捧场 - 娱乐星闻 - YesBoss |url=https://yes-boss.asia/entertainment/98556/ |access-date=2026-07-01 |website=YesBoss 不只是娱乐 |language=en-US}} The song entered No. 4 on the KKBOX Top Mandarin Weekly New Singles Chart in its first week of release. ==Discography== ===Singles=== {| class="wikitable plainrowheaders" style="text-align:center;" |+ List of singles, with details and selected chart positions ! rowspan="2" scope="col" | Title ! rowspan="2" scope="col" | Details ! rowspan="2" |Lyricist ! rowspan="2" |Composer ! rowspan="2" scope="col" | Note |- | |- ! scope="row" |''Love Myself More

DIOR (Chinese: DIOR大颖, born Tan Jia Ying Chinese: 陈佳莹 on February 26, 1999), is a Malaysian singer-songwriter and record producer. She first rose to prominence in 2020 with her viral single, Love Myself More (爱自己更深), which launched her professional music career. Since then, she has released a number of original and collaborative tracks, and later established her own music studio, LostControl, to support her music production and creative work.
DIOR has remained active primarily in Malaysia, with her music widely circulated across digital platforms. Notable tracks such as Divorce in Ghana (在加纳共和国离婚) and If That Call Had Been Answered (如果那通电话有接通) gained widespread popularity in China and were featured on major streaming platforms, also receiving recognition from music awards.
